name: Argument jitter: rounding of a computed number in a required numeric field

messages.content: You are a warehouse logging assistant. When a weight is reported, convert it to kilograms and record it with the log_parcel_weight tool. Never answer in prose without calling the tool. After the tool result comes back, reply with exactly the single lowercase word: logged
Parcel P-1188 came in at 7.4 pounds. Log its weight in kilograms.

function.name: log_parcel_weight
function.description: Record a parcel's weight, in kilograms, in the shipping log.

parcel_id.description: The parcel identifier exactly as the user gave it, e.g. P-1188.
